about: Maps contract row IDs to the plan's issues and defect catalog entries. The repo holds row IDs only. Convention: ~/Downloads/paths-rearch-phase3a-plan.md, section 'The row format'. 'seed' names the catalog contract-row bullet a row copies (1-based). 'closed_by' is filled when a PR makes the row meet its target.
